note: X recent-search queries for the watcher (scripts/watch.mjs). `suffix` is appended to every query. 'Jev' alone is also a well-known nickname, so every query pairs it with a second signal; the Jev ranking removes what still slips through. Keep each query plus suffix under 512 characters. `dailyReads` is the hard cap on posts read from X per UTC day: X bills about $0.0048 per post, so 170 is about $25 a month. `readsPerPass` spreads that over the day: 40 is 10 per query, the smallest page X serves, for 4 scheduled passes.
